capabilities: Show floating and selection toolbars for Markdown formatting commands
Build Markdown tables and convert CSV, TSV, or Markdown into tables
Insert links, embeds, footnotes, callouts, frontmatter, and code blocks
Add editable titles to fenced code blocks stored as title="..."
Insert Owen Graphite report snippets such as risk matrices and status badges
extras: Only the latest release's built files are kept for download; older release downloads and tag-based rollback links are removed. Part of a suite of Owen plugins (Graphite, Exporter, Mermaid) that work together but install separately.
intentEvidence: Bring writing, research, report drafting, table conversion, and Owen Graphite snippets into one editing toolbar.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in floating or selection toolbar, so common formatting, linking, table, and report-snippet actions require typing Markdown or memorizing commands.

relations.evidence: Graphite-specific classes such as wide-table, risk-table, ogd-status-badge, and ogd-reference-list need Owen Graphite for their intended visual treatment.
Owen Editor preferences use spaced, rounded section cards with inset row dividers, matching Owen Exporter's settings layout.
Exporting complete HTML documents or rasterizing SVG images is Owen Exporter's role; diagram visual editing is Owen Mermaid's role.

summary: Editing toolbar plugin that adds formatting commands, table building with CSV/TSV conversion, and Owen Graphite report snippets to Markdown notes.
